body:
From src/gateway/render-worker.ts's own residuals header, promoted to a ticket at the moment
the capabilities book stopped calling the whole sandbox unbuilt (T172 archived): the pool's
declared maxMemoryMb translates into worker resourceLimits, which cap the V8 HEAP and only
that. An ArrayBuffer's backing store is allocated outside the heap, so a bundle reaches
whatever the host has - measured before T172: a body allocating 600MB under a declared 128MB
ceiling ran to completion and took the host's RSS from 45MB to 665MB. The pool therefore
prints a ceiling it does not fully enforce.

A real bound needs an rlimit or a cgroup around a process, or a periodic sample of the
worker's own usage. Choosing among those is a design decision - this widens what SPEC sections
23.9/24.5 promise, so the landing is Myk's merge.

Acceptance criteria:
- (a) A bundle allocating far past the declared ceiling via ArrayBuffer backing stores is
  stopped or the render refused, two-sided with a within-ceiling bundle that completes.
  Verify: test/gateway/render-memory-bound.test.ts.
- (b) The envelope report never states a ceiling the mechanism cannot enforce - either the
  bound is real or the report names the soft half explicitly. Verify: the same suite, at the
  report level.
title: The pool's declared memory ceiling bounds the V8 heap, not the appetite
